title: Frequently asked questions
body: Quick answers to the most common questions about shipping, billing, and returns.

shipping.a: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days. Express shipping options at checkout deliver in 1-2 business days.

payment.q: What payment methods do you accept?
payment.a: All major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. Enterprise invoicing is available on request.

changes.q: Can I change or cancel my order?
changes.a: Yes — within the first hour after placing your order. After that, contact our support team and we'll help you sort it out.

international.a: We ship to over 50 countries. International delivery typically takes 7-14 business days. Customs fees may apply depending on your country.

returns.a: 30-day returns on most items in original condition. Some specialty items have different terms — noted on each product page.
